Value: A total sample size of 4790 is required to detect a difference in response proportions between the treatment and control groups based on a two-sided Fisher’s exact test with desired power 87%. The significance level is 0.0456, the proportion of responses in the control group and treatment groups are 0.06 and 0.04 respectively. Since the allocation ratio is 1, of the 4790 subjects, 2395 are allocated to the control arm and 2395 are allocated to the treatment arm.
